text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows machines to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large amounts of data to solve difficult problems. Today, AI is used in many daily activities. For example, it helps recommend films on streaming services, powers voice assistants on phones, and even helps doctors find diseases. AI is changing the way we live and work, and it will continue to grow in the future.
